name: Clock Tree Planner
blurb: PLL settings and peripheral clocks from a crystal frequency
intro: Searches every PLL divider combination the chip allows for the one that makes your system clock exactly, preferring a 48 MHz USB clock when asked, then sets the bus prescalers to the fastest legal values and reads off the timer clocks and flash wait states. Limits come from the ST reference manuals and the RP2040 datasheet.

examples.title: STM32F407, 8 MHz crystal, 168 MHz with USB

usage: Give the family (f407, f429, f411, g474, rp2040), the PLL source (hse or hsi), the crystal and wanted system clock in MHz, whether a 48 MHz USB clock is needed and the AHB prescaler. It returns the PLL dividers (PLLM/PLLN/PLLP/PLLQ or REFDIV/FBDIV/POSTDIV), VCO frequencies, HCLK, PCLK1/2, timer clocks, flash wait states, alternative settings and a HAL/SDK code snippet. Use it before writing SystemClock_Config or when a crystal choice has to support USB.
sources: ST RM0090 (STM32F405/407/427/429) §6.3.2 RCC_PLLCFGR and §3.5.1 flash latency
